headline_pain: Can Small Biz Still Buy Warehouses?
primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." Wondering if it's even possible anymore? It is — you just need to look off-market and off-the-plan. In Truganina, new warehouses are being built exclusively for small business owner-occupiers. No auction. Fixed pricing. Deposit secures your unit. You get a brand-new building near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne — without going head-to-head with cashed-up developers. The question isn't whether you can afford to buy. It's whether you can afford to keep losing.
description: Off-the-plan means you skip the auction market entirely — fixed price, no bidding.
